FORM.notes: kocisinse為日語，指校長。

S.FORM: teku, tumatuturu, poisua, tacin, niaranai, tauruu, kocisinse.
S.PHON: t[e|ə]ku tumatuturu poisua taʦin niaranai tauruu koʦisins[e|ə]
S.FORM: teku, tumatuturu, poisua, tacin, niaranai, tauruu, kocisinse.
S.PHON: teku tumatutu[r|ɾ]u poisua taʦin nia[r|ɾ]anai tau[r|ɾ]uu koʦisinse
S.TRANSL: 我要說關於一位來自大陸的校長。
I'm going to talk about a principal that comes from China.

FORM.notes: unʉm 是從unʉmʉ 簡化字尾母音後，拉長字中母音而得。

S.FORM: manasʉ, na, minkuo, masʉpatʉn, urima, nukai, unʉm.
S.PHON: manas* na minkuo mas*pat*n urima nukai un*m
S.FORM: manasʉ, na, minkuo, masʉpatʉn, urima, nukai, unʉm.
S.PHON: manasɨ na minkuo masɨpatɨn u[r|ɾ]ima nukai unɨm
S.TRANSL: 大約在民國四十五年或者四十六年。
It was in about Minkuo 45th or 46th year.

FORM.notes: kisʉ-ʉn有「說成」、「所謂」的意思。

S.FORM: mesua, tanasʉnmia, namasia, mesua ia, sanminsiang kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: m[e|ə]sua tanas*nmia namasia m[e|ə]sua ia sanminsiaŋ kis**n
S.FORM: mesua, tanasʉnmia, namasia, mesua ia, sanminsiang kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: mesua tanasɨnmia namasia mesua ia sanminsiaŋ kisɨɨn
S.TRANSL: 當時我們的部落納瑪夏被稱為三民鄉。
At that time, our tribe Namaasia was called Sanminsiang.

S.FORM: 'akia pakangvang, tanasa mocaca, cau mesua na. noten, mocaca, mokusa, maraa, aracen makai, kasanpo, aupoo, 'uru, kʉkʉ, kangvang mokusa 'inia.
S.PHON: ʔakia pakaŋvaŋ tanasa moʦaʦa ʦau m[e|ə]sua na not[e|ə]n moʦaʦa mokusa maraa araʦ[e|ə]n makai kasanpo aupoo ʔuru k*k* kaŋvaŋ mokusa ʔinia
S.FORM: 'akia pakangvang, tanasa mocaca, cau mesua na. noten, mocaca, mokusa, maraa, aracen makai, kasanpo, aupoo, 'uru, kʉkʉ, kangvang mokusa 'inia.
S.PHON: ʔakia pakaŋvaŋ tanasa moʦaʦa ʦau mesua na noten moʦaʦa mokusa ma[r|ɾ]aa a[r|ɾ]aʦen makai kasanpo aupoo ʔu[r|ɾ]u kɨkɨ kaŋvaŋ mokusa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: 都還沒有車子，當時的人如果要走去遠的地方，比如甲仙埔、大埔，都要徒步去那裏。
There wasn't any car. If people wanted to walk to the place that was far away such as Kasanpo and Aupoo, they would go there on foot.

FORM.notes: to’omang此為竹類的總稱。

S.FORM: 'akia tenki, kangvang siarupaca, sinʉng, po'ocipi, 'urupaca, kangvang, karu, to'omang.
S.PHON: ʔakia t[e|ə]nki kaŋvaŋ siarupaʦa sin*ŋ poʔoʦipi ʔurupaʦa kaŋvaŋ karu toʔomaŋ
S.FORM: 'akia tenki, kangvang siarupaca, sinʉng, po'ocipi, 'urupaca, kangvang, karu, to'omang.
S.PHON: ʔakia tenki kaŋvaŋ sia[r|ɾ]upaʦa sinɨŋ poʔoʦipi ʔu[r|ɾ]upaʦa kaŋvaŋ ka[r|ɾ]u toʔomaŋ
S.TRANSL: 沒有電器，所有使用的光、烹煮都要使用木材或者是竹子。
there wasn't electricity. All the light used and cooking needed to use timber and bamboo.

FORM.notes: cucumeen (其他的、另外的)由cucumeni簡化字尾子音並拉長字中母音而得。 此處sia-rupacaa 第一音節語音拉長。

S.FORM: 'akia kangvang, 'akia cucumeen kangvang sisiarupacaa.
S.PHON: ʔakia kaŋvaŋ ʔakia ʦuʦum[e|ə][e|ə]n kaŋvaŋ sisiarupaʦaa
S.FORM: 'akia kangvang, 'akia cucumeen kangvang sisiarupacaa.
S.PHON: ʔakia kaŋvaŋ ʔakia ʦuʦumeen kaŋvaŋ sisia[r|ɾ]upaʦaa
S.TRANSL: 沒有任何其他的可以使用。
There wasn't any other (tool) that could be used.

S.FORM: mesia, cau na, Namasia, Kanakanavu ia, matʉtʉa kangvang, maraa, muru'inasʉ.
S.PHON: m[e|ə]sia ʦau na namasia kanakanavu ia mat*t*a kaŋvaŋ maraa muruʔinas*
S.FORM: mesia, cau na, Namasia, Kanakanavu ia, matʉtʉa kangvang, maraa, muru'inasʉ.
S.PHON: mesia ʦau na namasia kanakanavu ia matɨtɨa kaŋvaŋ ma[r|ɾ]aa mu[r|ɾ]uʔinasɨ
S.TRANSL: 當時住在那瑪夏的Kanakanavu族人，都一樣比較艱困。
The Kanakanavu living in Namasia at that time were the same more industrious.

FORM.notes: 這裡的其他人是指別族的人。

S.FORM: imo, maraa ka'an, kim, cumacʉ'ʉra, cau cucumen.
S.PHON: imo maraa kaʔan kim ʦumaʦ*ʔ*ra ʦau ʦuʦum[e|ə]n
S.FORM: imo, maraa ka'an, kim, cumacʉ'ʉra, cau cucumen.
S.PHON: imo ma[r|ɾ]aa kaʔan kim ʦumaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a ʦau ʦuʦumen
S.TRANSL: 所以我們比較看不到其他的人。
So, we relatively couldn't see other people (from other tribes).

FORM.notes: manamanarʉ 指平地，跟原住民的居住地區分開來，但ningning特別指平原。

S.FORM: matʉa, sii, aracen, cucumen, ka'an kangvangkim, mokusa na, aracen, manamanarʉ.
S.PHON: mat*a sii araʦ[e|ə]n ʦuʦum[e|ə]n kaʔan kaŋvaŋkim mokusa na araʦ[e|ə]n manamanar*
S.FORM: matʉa, sii, aracen, cucumen, ka'an kangvangkim, mokusa na, aracen, manamanarʉ.
S.PHON: matɨa sii a[r|ɾ]aʦen ʦuʦumen kaʔan kaŋvaŋkim mokusa na a[r|ɾ]aʦen manamana[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 同樣地，因為很遠，我們也不去比較遠的平地。
Similarly, we wouldn't go to the farther level ground either because it was far away.

FORM.notes: tavarʉ’ʉ 可以解釋成「會、懂、可以、能」。 tavarʉ’ʉ有些人會說成tavʉrʉ’ʉ。 masii sumukun說布農話。 makari tacau跟狗說話。

S.FORM: surumo, 'una can taniara, nivatu, tacin, nanmarua. ka'an tavarʉ'ʉ masii Kanakanavu.
S.PHON: surumo ʔuna ʦan taniara nivatu taʦin nanmarua kaʔan tavar*ʔ* masii kanakanavu
S.FORM: surumo, 'una can taniara, nivatu, tacin, nanmarua. ka'an tavarʉ'ʉ masii Kanakanavu.
S.PHON: su[r|ɾ]umo ʔuna ʦan tania[r|ɾ]a nivatu taʦin nanma[r|ɾ]ua kaʔan tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ masii kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: 突然有一天，來了一位年輕人，不會說Kankanavu族語。
One day, there suddenly came a young man who couldn't speak Kanakanavu.

S.FORM: mesua, mamarangmia ia, maraa ka'an pa, tavarʉ'ʉ, masii, nakasaiana.
S.PHON: m[e|ə]sua mamaraŋmia ia maraa kaʔan pa tavar*ʔ* masii nakasaiana
S.FORM: mesua, mamarangmia ia, maraa ka'an pa, tavarʉ'ʉ, masii, nakasaiana.
S.PHON: mesua mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia ia ma[r|ɾ]aa kaʔan pa tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ masii nakasaiana
S.TRANSL: 當時我們的長輩們還不說國語。
At that time, our seniors were still not able to speak Mandarin.

S.FORM: kacaua pa cau mesua, masii ripun.
S.PHON: kaʦaua pa ʦau m[e|ə]sua masii ripun
S.FORM: kacaua pa cau mesua, masii ripun.
S.PHON: kaʦaua pa ʦau mesua masii [r|ɾ]ipun
S.TRANSL: 當時還有很多人說日語。
There were still many people speaking Japanese at that time.

FORM.notes: isi 這。 isua那/些(很明確的地點)。 ’isa 那/些(比較不明確的地點)。 nesi 這裡。 nesa 那裏。 sana 那裏(當下未必看得到) 。 nesua 那裏(說話者其中一人看得到)。

S.FORM: cumacʉ'ʉra, namarua isua iovutu.
S.PHON: ʦumaʦ*ʔ*ra namarua isua iovutu
S.FORM: cumacʉ'ʉra, namarua isua iovutu.
S.PHON: ʦumaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a nama[r|ɾ]ua isua iovutu
S.TRANSL: 看到那位年輕人來。
(People) saw the young man come.

FORM.notes: nan/nanu哪裡。 kisʉ-ʉn原形為kisa「所謂/稱為」。

S.FORM: pasin mamarangmia, niaranaikasunan iovutu kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: pasin mamaraŋmia niaranaikasunan iovutu kis**n
S.FORM: pasin mamarangmia, niaranaikasunan iovutu kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: pasin mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia nia[r|ɾ]anaikasunan iovutu kisɨɨn
S.TRANSL: 我們的長輩們對他說:＂你是從哪裡來的?＂
Our seniors said to him, "Where do you come from?"

S.FORM: marivari, nguain, makasi, niaranaiku, tauru.
S.PHON: marivari ŋuain makasi niaranaiku tauru
S.FORM: marivari, nguain, makasi, niaranaiku, tauru.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i ŋuain makasi nia[r|ɾ]anaiku tau[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 他回答說＂我來自大陸。＂
He replied, "I come from China."

FORM.notes: urima五; usʉpatu四，用在數物。

S.FORM: mesua, cʉ'ʉrʉn kan mamarangmia ia, nguain tamna cenana manasʉ, mapusan, uturu nukai, usʉpatʉ.
S.PHON: m[e|ə]sua ʦ*ʔ*r*n kan mamaraŋmia ia ŋuain tamna ʦ[e|ə]nana manas* mapusan uturu nukai us*pat*
S.FORM: mesua, cʉ'ʉrʉn kan mamarangmia ia, nguain tamna cenana manasʉ, mapusan, uturu nukai, usʉpatʉ.
S.PHON: mesua ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨn kan mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia ia ŋuain tamna ʦenana manasɨ mapusan utu[r|ɾ]u nukai usɨpatɨ
S.TRANSL: 據說當時長輩們看著他的年紀大約二十三或者二十四歲。
It is said that the seniors saw that he was at about the age of 23 or 24 at that time.

FORM.notes: arakukun指人或動物聚在一起。 ʉtʉmʉkʉnʉ (兩人以上在一起相處比較長的時間，可能長久居住下來) 。 muru’ucangʉ結婚。 ’ucangʉ 用來稱呼配偶。 saronai=maku 我的先生。 nanakʉ=maku 我的女人。 rʉ’ʉvʉ=maku 我的伴侶/夥伴。 tuma-tiuru 做-攪拌 「做攪拌的動作」。

S.FORM: arakicacʉ mamarangmia sii, tavarʉ'ʉ, masii ripun, arakukukuncu kanakanavu.
S.PHON: arakiʦaʦ* mamaraŋmia sii tavar*ʔ* masii ripun arakukukunʦu kanakanavu
S.FORM: arakicacʉ mamarangmia sii, tavarʉ'ʉ, masii ripun, arakukukuncu kanakanavu.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦɨ mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia sii tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ masii [r|ɾ]ipun a[r|ɾ]akukukunʦu kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: 我們長輩嚇了一跳，因為他竟然會說日語，就和Kanakanavu族人相處在一起了
Our seniors were too surprised because he was unexpectedly able to speak Japanese. And so (he) got along with the Kanakanavu people.

S.FORM: tumatuturucu nguain, makasi, tekan mon na minshengguoxiao, toisua, kocisinse.
S.PHON: tumatuturuʦu ŋuain makasi t[e|ə]kan mon na mins*[e|ə]ŋ*uo*iao toisua koʦisins[e|ə]
S.FORM: tumatuturucu nguain, makasi, tekan mon na minshengguoxiao, toisua, kocisinse.
S.PHON: tumatutu[r|ɾ]uʦu ŋuain makasi tekan mon na minsheŋ*uo*iao toisua koʦisinse
S.TRANSL: 他就說要待在民生國小當校長。
He said that he would stay at Minsheng Elementary School as the principal.

FORM.notes: cucuru 有「真的、非常、太、的確」的意思。

S.FORM: sua kocisinse isi ia, kari mamarangmia masii ripun, cucuru kari ʉngcoo nakasaiana ia xiaozhang kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: sua koʦisins[e|ə] isi ia kari mamaraŋmia masii ripun ʦuʦuru kari *ŋʦoo nakasaiana ia *iao**aŋ kis**n
S.FORM: sua kocisinse isi ia, kari mamarangmia masii ripun, cucuru kari ʉngcoo nakasaiana ia xiaozhang kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: sua koʦisinse isi ia ka[r|ɾ]i mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia masii [r|ɾ]ipun ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u ka[r|ɾ]i ɨŋʦoo nakasaiana ia *iao*haŋ kisɨɨn
S.TRANSL: ＂Kocisinse＂這句話是我們長輩用日語說的，中文真正的說法是＂校長＂。
The word, "kocisinse," is how our seniors said in Japanese. The correct way to say in Mandarin is "xiaozhang."

S.FORM: mesua, tati'ing pakim, ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ, ah nen tia vu, vuren, sua marisinatʉ misee, sii cucuru, 'akia tavara'amia.
S.PHON: m[e|ə]sua tatiʔiŋ pakim kaʔankim tavar*ʔ* a* n[e|ə]n tia vu vur[e|ə]n sua marisinat* mis[e|ə][e|ə] sii ʦuʦuru ʔakia tavaraʔamia
S.FORM: mesua, tati'ing pakim, ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ, ah nen tia vu, vuren, sua marisinatʉ misee, sii cucuru, 'akia tavara'amia.
S.PHON: mesua tatiʔiŋ pakim kaʔankim tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ ah nen tia vu vu[r|ɾ]en sua ma[r|ɾ]isinatɨ misee sii ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u ʔakia tava[r|ɾ]aʔamia
S.TRANSL: 當時我們的年紀還很小，不知道讀書會有什麼成果，因為的確我們懂的不多。
At that time, we were still too young, not knowing what achievement we could have from studying because what we know was surely little.

S.FORM: ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ marisinatʉ, nakasaiana, ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ pokarikari.
S.PHON: kaʔankim tavar*ʔ* marisinat* nakasaiana kaʔankim tavar*ʔ* pokarikari
S.FORM: ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ marisinatʉ, nakasaiana, ka'ankim tavarʉ'ʉ pokarikari.
S.PHON: kaʔankim tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ ma[r|ɾ]isinatɨ nakasaiana kaʔankim tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ poka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: 我們不會寫跟說中文。
We could not write and speak Mandarin.

S.FORM: tenoman, mokusa na tarisinata, mesua cʉpʉngmia.
S.PHON: t[e|ə]noman mokusa na tarisinata m[e|ə]sua ʦ*p*ŋmia
S.FORM: tenoman, mokusa na tarisinata, mesua cʉpʉngmia.
S.PHON: tenoman mokusa na ta[r|ɾ]isinata mesua ʦɨpɨŋmia
S.TRANSL: 當時我們在想＂去學校有什麼用?＂
At that time, we were thinking, "What is it for to go to school?"

S.FORM: nakai iovutucu, namaraa isua, tumatuturu kimia, sua nganaini kan ia, zhangjie kisʉʉn, niarainai na tauru.
S.PHON: nakai iovutuʦu namaraa isua tumatuturu kimia sua ŋanaini kan ia **aŋ*i[e|ə] kis**n niarainai na tauru
S.FORM: nakai iovutucu, namaraa isua, tumatuturu kimia, sua nganaini kan ia, zhangjie kisʉʉn, niarainai na tauru.
S.PHON: nakai iovutuʦu nama[r|ɾ]aa isua tumatutu[r|ɾ]u kimia sua ŋanaini kan ia *haŋjie kisɨɨn nia[r|ɾ]ainai na tau[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 但是那位年輕人來了之後，告訴我們說他的名字叫張傑，來自大陸。
But after that young man came, he told us that his name was Jhangjie and that he came from China.

FORM.notes: mocʉmcʉm 指趕早的行動。 paira 這裡是指每天。

S.FORM: makasuacu, mon nguain na, tarisinata si'icʉpʉ, paira mocʉmcʉm aramia'ʉ.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mon ŋuain na tarisinata siʔiʦ*p* paira moʦ*mʦ*m aramiaʔ*
S.FORM: makasuacu, mon nguain na, tarisinata si'icʉpʉ, paira mocʉmcʉm aramia'ʉ.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mon ŋuain na ta[r|ɾ]isinata siʔiʦɨpɨ pai[r|ɾ]a moʦɨmʦɨm a[r|ɾ]amiaʔɨ
S.TRANSL: 之後，他住在學校，每天很早起床。
afterwards, he lived in the school and woke up early every day.

FORM.notes: 孔老師原本要說mururu (擦拭)，此為用詞錯誤。

S.FORM: takacicin nguain, marisiki, mo'uru'uru ngʉcoo pangka.
S.PHON: takaʦiʦin ŋuain marisiki moʔuruʔuru ŋ*ʦoo paŋka
S.FORM: takacicin nguain, marisiki, mo'uru'uru ngʉcoo pangka.
S.PHON: takaʦiʦin ŋuain ma[r|ɾ]isiki moʔu[r|ɾ]uʔu[r|ɾ]u ŋɨʦoo paŋka
S.TRANSL: 每天自己打掃、擦桌子。
He cleaned up and wiped tables every day.

FORM.notes: mari-sinitʉ指讀書。

S.FORM: patimanʉngʉnkee, sua, tia to'onaa, a seto, marisinitʉ.
S.PHON: patiman*ŋ*nk[e|ə][e|ə] sua tia toʔonaa a s[e|ə]to marisinit*
S.FORM: patimanʉngʉnkee, sua, tia to'onaa, a seto, marisinitʉ.
S.PHON: patimanɨŋɨnkee sua tia toʔonaa a seto ma[r|ɾ]isinitɨ
S.TRANSL: 他把學生要讀書的地方整理得好好的。
He put away all the things in the classroom.

S.FORM: turupangcu, marisiki, mokusa XX na, si'inʉva, tarisinatʉ, maritarʉ, tecu iovutu seto.
S.PHON: turupaŋʦu marisiki mokusa ** na siʔin*va tarisinat* maritar* t[e|ə]ʦu iovutu s[e|ə]to
S.FORM: turupangcu, marisiki, mokusa XX na, si'inʉva, tarisinatʉ, maritarʉ, tecu iovutu seto.
S.PHON: tu[r|ɾ]upaŋʦu ma[r|ɾ]isiki mokusa ** na siʔinɨva ta[r|ɾ]isinatɨ ma[r|ɾ]ita[r|ɾ]ɨ teʦu iovutu seto
S.TRANSL: 打掃完後，就去校門口，等待學生要來了。
After cleaning up, he would go to the school gate and waited for the students to come.

FORM.notes: 在此孔老師又把「小朋友早」翻成族語再說一遍。 musu’ʉvʉ點頭致意、敬禮，引申為早安。

S.FORM: noo cumacʉ'ʉra na seto, mokusa ana ngʉcoo, si'inʉva ia, manasʉ kariin ia, siaupʉngiu cau misee, musu'ʉvʉ kamua.
S.PHON: noo ʦumaʦ*ʔ*ra na s[e|ə]to mokusa ana ŋ*ʦoo siʔin*va ia manas* kariin ia siaup*ŋiu ʦau mis[e|ə][e|ə] musuʔ*v* kamua
S.FORM: noo cumacʉ'ʉra na seto, mokusa ana ngʉcoo, si'inʉva ia, manasʉ kariin ia, siaupʉngiu cau misee, musu'ʉvʉ kamua.
S.PHON: noo ʦumaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a na seto mokusa ana ŋɨʦoo siʔinɨva ia manasɨ ka[r|ɾ]iin ia siaupɨŋiu ʦau misee musuʔɨvɨ kamua
S.TRANSL: 如果看到學生在校門口，通常他會說:＂小朋友早(中文)，早安。＂
If he saw student at the school gate, he would usually say "Siaopengyou zao. Musu'ʉvʉ kamua."

S.FORM: sii mesua ka'anpa nguain tavarʉ'ʉ masii Kanakanavu.
S.PHON: sii m[e|ə]sua kaʔanpa ŋuain tavar*ʔ* masii kanakanavu
S.FORM: sii mesua ka'anpa nguain tavarʉ'ʉ masii Kanakanavu.
S.PHON: sii mesua kaʔanpa ŋuain tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ masii kanakanavu
S.TRANSL: 因為那個時候他還不會說卡那卡那富語。
Because he was still not able to speak Kanakanavu at that time.

S.FORM: ketuturu nen, amusenkamu noo, cauan misee.
S.PHON: k[e|ə]tuturu n[e|ə]n amus[e|ə]nkamu noo ʦauan mis[e|ə][e|ə]
S.FORM: ketuturu nen, amusenkamu noo, cauan misee.
S.PHON: ketutu[r|ɾ]u nen amusenkamu noo ʦauan misee
S.TRANSL: 如果你們說＂早安＂要怎麼說?
If you say "Good morning," how (can I) say it?

FORM.notes: 孔老師認為taku- 有「形成」或是表示「從不懂到懂」的過程。

S.FORM: tuturuʉnmia, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ kisʉʉnmia, takutavarʉ'ʉcu,
S.PHON: tuturu*nmia musuʔ*v* tasiar* kis**nmia takutavar*ʔ*ʦu
S.FORM: tuturuʉnmia, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ kisʉʉnmia, takutavarʉ'ʉcu,
S.PHON: tutu[r|ɾ]uɨnmia musuʔɨvɨ tasia[r|ɾ]ɨ kisɨɨnmia takutava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨʦu
S.TRANSL: 我們教他＂musu’ʉvʉ tasiarʉ＂，就學會了。
We taught him "musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ" and then he learned it.

FORM.notes: musu’ʉvʉ tasiarʉ 意思為早安。 misee 如此說，前面會加上說了的內容。

S.FORM: noo cumacʉ'ra kimia ia totasiarʉ ia, makahicu, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ misee kimia.
S.PHON: noo ʦumaʦ*ʔra kimia ia totasiar* ia maka*iʦu musuʔ*v* tasiar* mis[e|ə][e|ə] kimia
S.FORM: noo cumacʉ'ra kimia ia totasiarʉ ia, makahicu, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ misee kimia.
S.PHON: noo ʦumaʦɨʔ[r|ɾ]a kimia ia totasia[r|ɾ]ɨ ia makahiʦu musuʔɨvɨ tasia[r|ɾ]ɨ misee kimia
S.TRANSL: 早上看到我們的時候，就說musu’ʉvʉ tasiarʉ。
When seeing us in the morning, He would say, "Good morning."

S.FORM: marivarikim, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ, misee.
S.PHON: marivarikim musuʔ*v* tasiar* mis[e|ə][e|ə]
S.FORM: marivarikim, musu'ʉvʉ tasiarʉ, misee.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]ikim musuʔɨvɨ tasia[r|ɾ]ɨ misee
S.TRANSL: 我們回答說:＂早安＂。
We replied, "Good morning."

FORM.notes: tarisinata 學校 由詞根 ta-ari-sinatʉ-a所組成，字面意義為拿書的地方。 para- 無法單獨成字，使…成動作; para-cani唱歌。

S.FORM: eh pacʉpʉcʉpʉngʉkim, mamanʉngana mokusa na, taarisinita, tavarʉ'ʉ, tumututuru kimia marisinatʉ, paracani.
S.PHON: [e|ə]* paʦ*p*ʦ*p*ŋ*kim maman*ŋana mokusa na taarisinita tavar*ʔ* tumututuru kimia marisinat* paraʦani
S.FORM: eh pacʉpʉcʉpʉngʉkim, mamanʉngana mokusa na, taarisinita, tavarʉ'ʉ, tumututuru kimia marisinatʉ, paracani.
S.PHON: eh paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋɨkim mamanɨŋana mokusa na taa[r|ɾ]isinita tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ tumututu[r|ɾ]u kimia ma[r|ɾ]isinatɨ pa[r|ɾ]aʦani
S.TRANSL: 我們心想能夠去學校真好啊!可以教我們讀書、唱歌。
We thought how good it was to go to school, which could teach us to sing and dance.

S.FORM: nakai noo, itumuru, 'umo'uma tamna, putukikioia, kacauacu seto mesua ka'ancu mosa na, taarisinata sii, tia moran mamarang, a, mo'uma.
S.PHON: nakai noo itumuru ʔumoʔuma tamna putukikioia kaʦauaʦu s[e|ə]to m[e|ə]sua kaʔanʦu mosa na taarisinata sii tia moran mamaraŋ a moʔuma
S.FORM: nakai noo, itumuru, 'umo'uma tamna, putukikioia, kacauacu seto mesua ka'ancu mosa na, taarisinata sii, tia moran mamarang, a, mo'uma.
S.PHON: nakai noo itumu[r|ɾ]u ʔumoʔuma tamna putukikioia kaʦauaʦu seto mesua kaʔanʦu mosa na taa[r|ɾ]isinata sii tia mo[r|ɾ]an mama[r|ɾ]aŋ a moʔuma
S.TRANSL: 但是當農事忙碌的時候，就很多學生不去學校，因為要幫忙長輩們做農事。
But when the farming business was busy, many students wouldn't go to school because they needed to help their seniors do farming.

FORM.notes: acuu 指去了。 nan 是 nanu 的簡化。

S.FORM: noo, takutavarʉ'ʉ, kosicinse isua, mokusacu na, taira, mokusa na 'umo'umamia, tikirim seto acuu nankamu misen 'an iovutu misee.
S.PHON: noo takutavar*ʔ* kosiʦins[e|ə] isua mokusaʦu na taira mokusa na ʔumoʔumamia tikirim s[e|ə]to aʦuu nankamu mis[e|ə]n ʔan iovutu mis[e|ə][e|ə]
S.FORM: noo, takutavarʉ'ʉ, kosicinse isua, mokusacu na, taira, mokusa na 'umo'umamia, tikirim seto acuu nankamu misen 'an iovutu misee.
S.PHON: noo takutava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ kosiʦinse isua mokusaʦu na tai[r|ɾ]a mokusa na ʔumoʔumamia tiki[r|ɾ]im seto aʦuu nankamu misen ʔan iovutu misee
S.TRANSL: 當那位校長獲知之後，就去曠野，到我們的田裡找學生說:＂你們去哪裡了，為什麼不來?＂
When the principal knew it (students' doing farming), he would go to the open field. (He would) go to our farmland and find the students, saying "Where did you go? Why didn't you come?"

FORM.notes: tarisinita一詞由ta-ari-sinitʉ-a所組成。

S.FORM: matisa'ʉ kimia ah, avicin, mavici ʉngcoo oh manu tati'ing, umavici na, taarisinita.
S.PHON: matisaʔ* kimia a* aviʦin maviʦi *ŋʦoo o* manu tatiʔiŋ umaviʦi na taarisinita
S.FORM: matisa'ʉ kimia ah, avicin, mavici ʉngcoo oh manu tati'ing, umavici na, taarisinita.
S.PHON: matisaʔɨ kimia ah aviʦin maviʦi ɨŋʦoo oh manu tatiʔiŋ umaviʦi na taa[r|ɾ]isinita
S.TRANSL: 抓著我們喔，帶著小朋友到學校。
grabbing us (the little kids), he brought the little kids to school.

S.FORM: 'apanapa, arakuracʉ mamarangmia, misen cau makasia,
S.PHON: ʔapanapa arakuraʦ* mamaraŋmia mis[e|ə]n ʦau makasia
S.FORM: 'apanapa, arakuracʉ mamarangmia, misen cau makasia,
S.PHON: ʔapanapa a[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]aʦɨ mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia misen ʦau makasia
S.TRANSL: 我們的長輩們有時候會很生氣，怎麼會這樣啊?
Our seniors got very angry from time to time. How would it be so?

FORM.notes: 此時語境有暗示「竟然」會發生這種事情。

S.FORM: tia moran kimia manu putukikio, avicinkee mokusa na tarisinita.
S.PHON: tia moran kimia manu putukikio aviʦink[e|ə][e|ə] mokusa na tarisinita
S.FORM: tia moran kimia manu putukikio, avicinkee mokusa na tarisinita.
S.PHON: tia mo[r|ɾ]an kimia manu putukikio aviʦinkee mokusa na ta[r|ɾ]isinita
S.TRANSL: 小朋友要幫我們工作，還把小孩子帶去學校。
The little kids would help us work. Should (he) take the kids to school.

FORM.notes: miana此處為口誤，應為nuari未來。 此時cʉpʉng表示想法。

S.FORM: makasicu ʉngcoo, cang siaucang isua, parisinitoo manumu, kan tia arakaranananguain tam nguani tamna, cʉpʉng miana.
S.PHON: makasiʦu *ŋʦoo ʦaŋ siauʦaŋ isua parisinitoo manumu kan tia arakarananaŋuain tam ŋuani tamna ʦ*p*ŋ miana
S.FORM: makasicu ʉngcoo, cang siaucang isua, parisinitoo manumu, kan tia arakaranananguain tam nguani tamna, cʉpʉng miana.
S.PHON: makasiʦu ɨŋʦoo ʦaŋ siauʦaŋ isua pa[r|ɾ]isinitoo manumu kan tia a[r|ɾ]aka[r|ɾ]ananaŋuain tam ŋuani tamna ʦɨpɨŋ miana
S.TRANSL: 那位張校長就如此說:要讓你們的小孩讀書，他們未來的想法會改變的。
That Principal Jhang said in this way, "Let your children go to school and their thoughts will change in the future."

FORM.notes: cʉvʉrʉ指生長，加了前綴sia-就有「生活方式」的意思。

S.FORM: tia aramamanʉng, ikamu tamna, siacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: tia aramaman*ŋ ikamu tamna siaʦ*v*r*
S.FORM: tia aramamanʉng, ikamu tamna, siacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: tia a[r|ɾ]amamanɨŋ ikamu tamna siaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 你們的生活方式會變好的。
Your ways of living will become good.

FORM.notes: taku-tavarʉ’ʉ 有暗示從不明白到明白的過程，taku-形成。

S.FORM: makasuacu macasʉcu XX niarakukunmia, takutavarʉ'ʉ mamarangmia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maʦas*ʦu ** niarakukunmia takutavar*ʔ* mamaraŋmia
S.FORM: makasuacu macasʉcu XX niarakukunmia, takutavarʉ'ʉ mamarangmia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maʦasɨʦu ** nia[r|ɾ]akukunmia takutava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia
S.TRANSL: 就那樣，我們相處久了，我們的長輩們也了解(那位校長)了。
In that way, we got along for so long. Our seniors also understood (that principal).

FORM.notes: nakasaiana 中國人，漢語，中文。

S.FORM: cucuruava, mokusa na taarisinata mamanmita, niarakaranana ti'ingcu, tavarʉ'ʉcu sumasʉpʉrʉ, ah ti'ing, tavarʉ'ʉ ti'ing masii, Nakasaiana.
S.PHON: ʦuʦuruava mokusa na taarisinata mamanmita niarakaranana tiʔiŋʦu tavar*ʔ*ʦu sumas*p*r* a* tiʔiŋ tavar*ʔ* tiʔiŋ masii nakasaiana
S.FORM: cucuruava, mokusa na taarisinata mamanmita, niarakaranana ti'ingcu, tavarʉ'ʉcu sumasʉpʉrʉ, ah ti'ing, tavarʉ'ʉ ti'ing masii, Nakasaiana.
S.PHON: ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]uava mokusa na taa[r|ɾ]isinata mamanmita nia[r|ɾ]aka[r|ɾ]anana tiʔiŋʦu tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨʦu sumasɨpɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ ah tiʔiŋ tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ tiʔiŋ masii nakasaiana
S.TRANSL: 的確，我們的小朋友去了學校之後，稍微有點改變喔，會念一點中文。
Truly, after our little kids went to school, (They) changed slightly, being able to read a little Chinese.

FORM.notes: ’ʉna 故事。 po-ʉna 說故事。 po-’ʉ’ʉna 一直說故事。 對Kanakanavu人來說，聊天就是講古。

S.FORM: makasuacu, pairacu nguain, rorovana ia mokusa na, tanasʉn arakukun mamarang, parʉ'ʉna.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu pairaʦu ŋuain rorovana ia mokusa na tanas*n arakukun mamaraŋ par*ʔ*na
S.FORM: makasuacu, pairacu nguain, rorovana ia mokusa na, tanasʉn arakukun mamarang, parʉ'ʉna.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu pai[r|ɾ]aʦu ŋuain [r|ɾ]o[r|ɾ]ovana ia mokusa na tanasɨn a[r|ɾ]akukun mama[r|ɾ]aŋ pa[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨna
S.TRANSL: 之後，晚上的時候，他經常來到社區，跟老人家相處聊天。
Afterwards, he often came to the community at night and accompanied the seniors, chatting with them.

FORM.notes: c<um>acʉvʉrʉ在這裡指一起生活。

S.FORM: ah, macasʉ taniarʉ, makaicu nguain, mamarangmia, kinvavarangmia, arakukun kimia kavang, cumacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: a* maʦas* taniar* makaiʦu ŋuain mamaraŋmia kinvavaraŋmia arakukun kimia kavaŋ ʦumaʦ*v*r*
S.FORM: ah, macasʉ taniarʉ, makaicu nguain, mamarangmia, kinvavarangmia, arakukun kimia kavang, cumacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: ah maʦasɨ tania[r|ɾ]ɨ makaiʦu ŋuain mama[r|ɾ]aŋmia kinvava[r|ɾ]aŋmia a[r|ɾ]akukun kimia kavaŋ ʦumaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 他就像我們的長輩，像我們的兄弟姊妹們，跟我們在一起生活。
He's just like our senior relatives and our siblings, living with us.

W.TRANSL: relation-重疊-兄弟姊妹=1PL.屬格.排除

FORM.notes: 'esi指存在；mon指待在。 te-ku mon nesi k<um>akʉn 我要待在這裡吃。

S.FORM: imo, mesua, arakacauacu, seto, mamancu mokusa na taarisinita arakukun nia mon nia marisinitʉ.
S.PHON: imo m[e|ə]sua arakaʦauaʦu s[e|ə]to mamanʦu mokusa na taarisinita arakukun nia mon nia marisinit*
S.FORM: imo, mesua, arakacauacu, seto, mamancu mokusa na taarisinita arakukun nia mon nia marisinitʉ.
S.PHON: imo mesua a[r|ɾ]akaʦauaʦu seto mamanʦu mokusa na taa[r|ɾ]isinita a[r|ɾ]akukun nia mon nia ma[r|ɾ]isinitɨ
S.TRANSL: 所以，當時很多學生變成喜歡去學校跟他相處，在那裡讀書。
So, many students got to like going to the school to get along with him and study there.

FORM.notes: 因為「知識」無法測量，所以用「變大變多」來說明獲得很多知識。

S.FORM: makasuacu, 'unacu, cau mokusa na namanamarʉ marisinitʉ, aratatia nguain tamna, takutavara'a, araitumuru nguain tamna takutavara'a.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʔunaʦu ʦau mokusa na namanamar* marisinit* aratatia ŋuain tamna takutavaraʔa araitumuru ŋuain tamna takutavaraʔa
S.FORM: makasuacu, 'unacu, cau mokusa na namanamarʉ marisinitʉ, aratatia nguain tamna, takutavara'a, araitumuru nguain tamna takutavara'a.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ʔunaʦu ʦau mokusa na namanama[r|ɾ]ɨ ma[r|ɾ]isinitɨ a[r|ɾ]atatia ŋuain tamna takutava[r|ɾ]aʔa a[r|ɾ]aitumu[r|ɾ]u ŋuain tamna takutava[r|ɾ]aʔa
S.TRANSL: 之後，有人去平地讀書，懂得更多了。
Afterwards, some people went to the plain area for study, knowing much more.

FORM.notes: manʉngʉ 好。

S.FORM: poi'i na tanasʉmia moran cau, pakamamanʉng.
S.PHON: poiʔi na tanas*mia moran ʦau pakamaman*ŋ
S.FORM: poi'i na tanasʉmia moran cau, pakamamanʉng.
S.PHON: poiʔi na tanasɨmia mo[r|ɾ]an ʦau pakamamanɨŋ
S.TRANSL: 回到部落協助族人更好。
(They) returned to the tribe, helping the tribal men lead a better life.

S.FORM: pacʉpʉcʉcʉngmia, ah, 'unava, kocisinse makasia tumatuturu kimia pakamamanʉng, tanasʉmia.
S.PHON: paʦ*p*ʦ*ʦ*ŋmia a* ʔunava koʦisins[e|ə] makasia tumatuturu kimia pakamaman*ŋ tanas*mia
S.FORM: pacʉpʉcʉcʉngmia, ah, 'unava, kocisinse makasia tumatuturu kimia pakamamanʉng, tanasʉmia.
S.PHON: paʦɨpɨʦɨʦɨŋmia ah ʔunava koʦisinse makasia tumatutu[r|ɾ]u kimia pakamamanɨŋ tanasɨmia
S.TRANSL: 我們心想著，啊，原來有這樣的校長，教我們使我們的部落更好。
We thought "Ah, there turns out to be such a principal who teaches us to make our tribe better."

S.FORM: imo, miaranaucu, kocisinse iisi, aratʉkʉn na tanasʉn, niaraaka, kacaua cau ikim kanakanavu pacʉpʉcʉpʉng 'inia.
S.PHON: imo miaranauʦu koʦisins[e|ə] iisi arat*k*n na tanas*n niaraaka kaʦaua ʦau ikim kanakanavu paʦ*p*ʦ*p*ŋ ʔinia
S.FORM: imo, miaranaucu, kocisinse iisi, aratʉkʉn na tanasʉn, niaraaka, kacaua cau ikim kanakanavu pacʉpʉcʉpʉng 'inia.
S.PHON: imo mia[r|ɾ]anauʦu koʦisinse iisi a[r|ɾ]atɨkɨn na tanasɨn nia[r|ɾ]aaka kaʦaua ʦau ikim kanakanavu paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ ʔinia
S.TRANSL: 所以，雖然這位校長離開部落很久了也過世了，我們Kanakanavu族人還是很思念著他。
So, though the principal has left the tribe for a long time, we Kanakanavu still miss him a lot.

FORM.notes: mama’ari sia-cʉvʉrʉ=maku 我的生活還不錯。mama’ari稍好/不錯。

S.FORM: tiavakita ketuturu 'inia makasua, moran na cau, pakamamunʉng na cau, masii, aramamanʉng kangvang, cau tamna, siacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: tiavakita k[e|ə]tuturu ʔinia makasua moran na ʦau pakamamun*ŋ na ʦau masii aramaman*ŋ kaŋvaŋ ʦau tamna siaʦ*v*r*
S.FORM: tiavakita ketuturu 'inia makasua, moran na cau, pakamamunʉng na cau, masii, aramamanʉng kangvang, cau tamna, siacʉvʉrʉ.
S.PHON: tiavakita ketutu[r|ɾ]u ʔinia makasua mo[r|ɾ]an na ʦau pakamamunɨŋ na ʦau masii a[r|ɾ]amamanɨŋ kaŋvaŋ ʦau tamna siaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 我們原來要學他那種幫助別人、讓別人好的作為，才能使族人的生活都獲得改善。
It is the case that we learn the very way he helped others and made others live well. In so doing, (he) could improve the lives of the tribal men.

S.FORM: matarava masin, ikim Kanakanavu, noo, parʉ'ʉna poisua kocisinse cangsiaucang ia, 'esi pakim, pacʉpʉcʉpʉng 'inia.
S.PHON: matarava masin ikim kanakanavu noo par*ʔ*na poisua koʦisins[e|ə] ʦaŋsiauʦaŋ ia ʔ[e|ə]si pakim paʦ*p*ʦ*p*ŋ ʔinia
S.FORM: matarava masin, ikim Kanakanavu, noo, parʉ'ʉna poisua kocisinse cangsiaucang ia, 'esi pakim, pacʉpʉcʉpʉng 'inia.
S.PHON: mata[r|ɾ]ava masin ikim kanakanavu noo pa[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨna poisua koʦisinse ʦaŋsiauʦaŋ ia ʔesi pakim paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ ʔinia
S.TRANSL: 直到現在我們Kanakanavu族人聊到張校長的時候，我們還在思念著他。
Up to now, whenever we Kanakanavu talk about Principal Zhang, we still miss him.

S.FORM: 'una kari, makasi, sua cangsiaucang kan ia, Kanakanavu tamna, kocisinse, matarava, nuari.
S.PHON: ʔuna kari makasi sua ʦaŋsiauʦaŋ kan ia kanakanavu tamna koʦisins[e|ə] matarava nuari
S.FORM: 'una kari, makasi, sua cangsiaucang kan ia, Kanakanavu tamna, kocisinse, matarava, nuari.
S.PHON: ʔuna ka[r|ɾ]i makasi sua ʦaŋsiauʦaŋ kan ia kanakanavu tamna koʦisinse mata[r|ɾ]ava nua[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: 所以，有這麼一說，張校長是我們Kanakanavu族人永遠的校長。
Therefore, it is said that Principal Zhang is our Kanakanavu's principal for good.
